name: KDP DSD Distribution Center - Tempe AZ

fieldNotes.location: Roster address (1850 W University Dr) is explicitly approximate and geocoded to an office building. Resolved actual KDP Tempe DSD facility to the former Kalil Bottling Co. plant at 2777 S Hardy Dr, Tempe AZ 85282 (Kalil acquired by KDP May 2024). Facility is the beverage bottling + DSD distribution complex on S Hardy Dr immediately south of the Broadway Rd / S Hardy Dr intersection.
fieldNotes.campus: multipleFacilities true — connected building cluster with a central tank/silo farm (bottling), warehouse with dock doors, and an open DSD fleet yard. A portion fronting S Hardy Dr carries a small 'Schreiber' sign (Schreiber Foods, 2122 S Hardy Dr, occupies adjacent space in the same industrial complex); precise parcel boundary between the KDP/Kalil and Schreiber footprints is ambiguous from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large open paved yard holds two long diagonal rows of DSD route delivery trucks (bay/box beverage trucks) plus a row of 53' trailers — classic DSD fleet staging.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Perimeter has chain-link fencing with oleander hedge along the S Hardy Dr frontage; driveway openings break the fence at the NW yard and along Hardy Dr. No staffed guard booth visible in Street View or satellite — controlled but unmanned access, so remoteGs true.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~18 dock doors estimated across the south warehouse face and plant building; partly obscured by trailers and roof structures — low confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Tempe industrial corridor inside the Phoenix metro — Urban.
